messages.subject: libstanc.a linking help
parts:
TLDR: Linking against stan for a gRPC prototype fails for me, I think I just don't understand the right strategy for linking to Stan, the error message is at the bottom. I'm looking at cmdstan makefiles to see how to do this right but if the error message rings a bell I'd appreciate any help.

Last week I re-did the "hello world" example from Google's protobuf remote procedure call implementation (gRPC) to call stan::lang::compile. The gRPC side was pretty straightforward since the original example is text -> text (wrapped in protobuf) and stan::lang::compile also does text -> text. The entire thing compiles, and I resolved all the gRPC issues that came up in linking. I'm stuck on linking stan-related code. The project code is at:

https://github.com/sakrejda/servestan

Currently the project has a stan submodule and I go to the submodule and use "make bin/libstanc.a" to generate a libstanc.a, then I do the same sort of thing for protobuf/gRPC and finally call g++ as:

g++ -std=c++11 -O3 -v -Wall -pipe -c \
-DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS \
-I src \
-I lib/stan/src/ \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/ \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/lib/eigen_3.2.4 \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/lib/boost_1.58.0 \
-I lib/grpc/include/ \
-I lib/grpc/third_party/protobuf/src/ \
src/servestan/servestan.cpp \
src/proto/stanc.grpc.pb.cc \
src/proto/stanc.pb.cc

That all compiles fine, then for linking (I'm sure there's cruft in here since I did not understand the g++ flags when I started...):

g++ -std=c++11 -O3 -v -Wall -pipe \
-DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS \
-isystem lib/stan/src/ \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/ \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/lib/boost_1.58.0 \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/lib/eigen_3.2.4 \
-o bin/servestan.o \
-isystem lib/stan/lib/stan_math_2.9.0/ \
servestan.o \
stanc.grpc.pb.o \
stanc.pb.o \
lib/stan/bin/libstanc.a \
lib/grpc/libs/opt/libgrpc++_unsecure.so \
lib/grpc/libs/opt/libgrpc_unsecure.so \
lib/grpc/libs/opt/libgrpc.so \
lib/grpc/libs/opt/libgpr.so \
lib/grpc/third_party/protobuf/src/.libs/libprotobuf.a \
-lpthread -ldl


If I don't include lib/stan/bin/libstanc.a, I get a lot more messages about undefined references to Stan functions, but even when I include it as above, I get:


servestan.o: In function `stan::lang::generate_initializer(std::ostream&, std::__cxx11::basic_string<char, std::char_traits<char>, std::allocator<char> > const&, std::vector<stan::lang::expression, std::allocator<stan::lang::expression> > const&, stan::lang::expression const&, stan::lang::expression const&)':
servestan.cpp:(.text+0x4e65): undefined reference to `stan::lang::expression::expression(boost::variant<boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::nil>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::int_literal>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::double_literal>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::array_literal>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::variable>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::integrate_ode>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::fun>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::index_op>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::index_op_sliced>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::binary_op>, boost::recursive_wrapper<stan::lang::unary_op> > const&)'

Full g++ output on linking if it's relevant is just dumped in the repo at the moment...

https://github.com/sakrejda/servestan/blob/master/output.txt

Thanks for any help!

Krzysztof
